{
  "root_cause": "The offcanvas component conditionally activates the focus trap based on the scroll configuration. When data-bs-scroll=\"true\" is present (as in the test), the focus trap is not activated, allowing focus to escape to underlying elements when Tab is pressed.",
  "repair_strategy": "Always activate the focus trap when showing the offcanvas, regardless of the scroll setting, by removing the conditional check in the show method's complete callback.",
  "edits": [
    {
      "path": "js/src/offcanvas.js",
      "sha256": "8008243ad710528ccfdcada0687a6c260bd75c80964dcae1fa020fc9aa2e4f1d",
      "before": "    const completeCallBack = () => {\n      if (!this._config.scroll) {\n        this._focustrap.activate()\n      }\n\n      this._element.classList.add(CLASS_NAME_SHOW)\n      this._element.classList.remove(CLASS_NAME_SHOWING)\n      EventHandler.trigger(this._element, EVENT_SHOWN, { relatedTarget })\n    }",
    "after": "    const completeCallBack = () => {\n      this._focustrap.activate()\n\n      this._element.classList.add(CLASS_NAME_SHOW)\n      this._element.classList.remove(CLASS_NAME_SHOWING)\n      EventHandler.trigger(this._element, EVENT_SHOWN, { relatedTarget })\n    }"
  }
],
  "expected_accessibility_effect": "Focus will remain trapped inside the offcanvas panel when navigating with Tab, ensuring that successive Tab presses cycle focus within the panel instead of moving focus to elements behind it.",
  "functional_risks": [
    "Potential side effects if any consumer relied on the focus trap being disabled when scroll:true; however, the scroll option is intended to control background scrolling, not focus trapping, so risk is low.",
    "Users who expect to interact with background content when scroll is enabled may find focus trapped, but offcanvas is typically modal and keeping focus trapped aligns with modal expectations."
  ],
  "verification_requirements": [
    "Verify that pressing Tab while the offcanvas is open keeps focus inside the panel.",
    "Verify that Escape still closes the offcanvas.",
    "Verify that the close button receives focus when opening via Enter.",
    "Verify that scrolling behavior (when scroll:true) remains unchanged (background scrolling allowed).",
    "Ensure that the offcanvas can still be dismissed via backdrop click if configured."
  ]
}
